summary: Parked-up residential kerb mid-block, with homes 11-21 m away.

best_section.where: North kerb between the two unit blocks, about 50 m before the east junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m at 108 m and 8 m from 131 m; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so room to stop beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moderate traffic and a junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: Cars clearly park here; a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% here, 8.7% over whole kerb
Dwellings within 10-25 m on the same side
Rest of the stretch is steeper, up to 16%
sun_shade: Street trees and unit-block planting shade it from the north; afternoon sun from the west.
